messages:
nora: Heads-up — NovaMed activity is down ~46% week-over-week after we handed off onboarding. Dash: https://redwood.internal/telemetry/novamed (big fall on /chat and /embeddings).

jamal: Looking now. Customer flipped an auth provider change per their internal ticket on 2025-05-14; runbook shows a config change but no final smoke sign-off on our side.

rachel: AE note — procurement said they're watching a demo from RivalAI next Wed. This is a near-term renewal risk if we don't show quick recovery.

pavan: Quick triage plays: 1) Scoped API-key fallback for a named service account to restore user sessions. 2) Offer a 7-14 day dedicated burst pool and an applied credit to ease cost concern. 3) Exec sync with NovaMed + procurement within 48hrs.

nora: Core endpoints: `POST /v1/chat`, `POST /v1/embeddings`, plus a nightly bulk rerank job. Those saw the biggest drops.

jamal: Logs show elevated `401` and a handful of `504` around 2025-05-14T07:30Z correlating with the provider switch. Pushing compressed log snippets to the folder.

rachel: Elena from NovaMed is on copy — she reported "session failures and intermittent 401s, users saw chat timeout errors." Looping her in.

pavan: I'll model the burst-pool cost delta + expected P95/P99 improvements and a short customer-facing ROI blurb by EOD.

jamal: I'll prep a canary rollback plan and rehearse a non-disruptive API-key fallback in staging. Need sign-off from NovaMed infra for the key rollout.

incident-bot: Created incident INC-20250514-NOVAMED-AUTH for auth spikes and elevated error rate. PagerDuty notified.

rachel: Owners: @jamal — rollback & canary (owner). @pavan — cost + customer ROI (owner). @nora — customer comms + schedule exec sync (owner). I'll assemble procurement talking points.

nora: Will draft a short calming note to procurement and request the infra sign-off. If canary looks good we'll push the scoped keys and the short burst while we fix the root cause.

pavan: Sharing a compact runbook snippet for temporary API-key fallback in 15m.

jamal: CSV of seats that dropped sent via DM to owners. Aim to present mitigations and cost delta Tue AM to preempt RivalAI demo next Wed. :thumbsup:
